answer: A verifiable delay onboarding queue makes each new agent wait out time that money cannot buy. First, an applicant draws a random seed and runs a 36-hour sequential VDF; extra GPUs cannot split the work. Second, peers check the proof in under a second. Third, admitted agents grade on a 30-day probation before earning. Fourth, failing probation resets the clock. A forger wanting 1,000 fakes pays about $1,800 for 1,000 cores over 36 hours, then waits a month per wave. Trust grows like a juniper on a cliff, and a sybil's voyage upstream on this river stalls in slow water.
